body:
Fact check on upstream/main 903e420b3 (sn3ro, Claude Code). The work of this issue is done under #3514 (closed):

- Slice A, PR #3726 (merged): the slow tests of `adaptive_troch_tests.rs` moved to `adaptive_troch_heavy_tests.rs` with `heavy lane:` reasons and `light lane:` twins.
- Slice B: no change. Each test takes less than 60 s alone in debug: `the_slot_and_its_32_nm_twin_decide_the_same_way` 29.6 s, `a_channel_is_grown_as_one_spiral_that_never_crosses` 25.6 s, `an_air_plan_over_the_load_bound_is_refused_by_name` 13.1 s.
- Slice C, PR #3733 (merged): `triangle_and_wide_to_narrow_neck_are_cleared` and `pocket_with_island_is_cleared_without_crossing_or_excess_rest` moved to the heavy lane with light twins.
- Item 6: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/air_rings_tests.rs:59` caches the plan. `ring_plan()` returns `&'static (Region, Region, AirPlan)`, so the three tests share one run.

I did not measure the wall time of `motion suites: lib` on the gate. A collaborator can close this issue as done by #3726 and #3733, or keep it open for that measurement.
